name: JHU Biomedical Engineering B.S.
note: Unofficial — verify with your advisor. Transcribed Nov 2026 from the e-catalogue page for students entering Fall 2026. Not modelled: grade minimums, ePortfolio assignments (FA1.1eP, FA1.2eP, FA5eP, FA6eP — carried by the Core Electives and Design Sequence), and Career Exploration in BME (0 credits). Courses the catalogue double-counts toward FA2/FA5 (Calculus, Probability & Statistics, Gateway Computing, one science + lab, EN.580.111) are listed once, under Mathematics / Basic Sciences / BME Core.

groups.name: Mathematics (min. 20 credits)
groups.note: A waiver for Calculus I/II must be replaced with AS.110 or EN.553 courses at the 200 level or higher.

groups.name: Basic Sciences (min. 18 credits)
groups.note: With exam credit for Chemistry I and its lab, take AS.030.103 instead of AS.030.102 + AS.030.106.

groups.name: Design (8 credits)
groups.note: Each two-semester sequence must be taken in its entirety.
